official: 横浜市事務分掌条例の一部改正

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 市役所の局を再編し担当を変更
summary: 現在、市の事務は複数の局や本部に分かれて担当しています。この議案では、新たな本部と局を設けるほか、複数の局の名称や担当事務を組み替えます。令和8年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 防災・危機管理統括本部を設け、防災・減災や市民の安全などを担当させる
行財政局を設け、行政改革、デジタル化、財政、職員の人事などを担当させる
政策経営局を政策経営・国際戦略局に、道路局を道路・交通政策局に改める
建築局・都市整備局の担当事務と、関連する審議会などの事務局担当を改める
why: 市民の暮らしの充実と安心を確保し、将来の横浜の活力を高める執行体制を整えるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Reorganizes city hall bureaus and changes their responsibilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Yokohama City Ordinance on the Allocation of Administrative Responsibilities
en.summary: The city’s administrative responsibilities are currently divided among several bureaus and headquarters. This bill would establish a new headquarters and bureau, and reorganize the names and responsibilities of several bureaus. It would take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Establishes a Disaster Prevention and Crisis Management Headquarters to handle disaster prevention and mitigation, public safety, and related matters
Establishes an Administrative and Financial Affairs Bureau to handle administrative reform, digitalization, finance, and personnel matters
Renames the Policy Management Bureau as the Policy Management and International Strategy Bureau, and the Road Bureau as the Road and Transportation Policy Bureau
Revises the responsibilities of the Building Bureau and Urban Development Bureau, as well as which departments handle secretariat duties for related councils and other bodies
en.why: The city says this is to establish an administrative structure that supports residents’ well-being and security and boosts Yokohama’s vitality in the future.
